title: Stripelands Viewer
description: This mod expands the worldborder in 14w30a allowing you to view the chunk stripelands.
body:
# Stripelands Viewer

This mod allows you to see a unique feature of snapshots 14w30a and 14w30b, the chunk stripelands!

These two versions are special, due to them being the only two versions since infdev to contain a version of the stripelands within the 32bit integer limit.

This mod also removes the worldborder for these versions. It's built on top of (and works best on) 14w30a, however 14w30b is also supported.

### WARNING
Epilepsy warning: flashing lights at far distances! Enable VBOs if you just wish to use this for playing far beyond 30 million!
